- Proactive mindset with the ability to work independently.
- Strong time-management and prioritization skills.
- Comfortable supporting multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, remote environment.
- Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) after 3 months
- Extra Holiday Pay
